name: Sudeep Pharma Limited
summary: Sudeep Pharma Limited, founded in 1989 and headquartered in Vadodara, India, makes and distributes excipients and specialty ingredients for the pharmaceutical, food and nutrition industries. It sells in the United States, Europe, the UK and Latin America. Its range includes mineral salts such as calcium, zinc, iron and magnesium, and calcium carbonate used as an active pharmaceutical ingredient.
